Operating primarily through social engineering tactics, Madi has demonstrated a focus on compromising sensitive systems to achieve financial gain while disrupting critical infrastructure.

Their targeting profile reflects a focus on sectors that hold sensitive data, such as government and financial services, which can yield significant financial rewards. Typical victims include engineering firms, government agencies, and academic institutions.
